narrative_purpose: The dim full-bleed mood layer the chapter's text floats over: a vast forest of life seen from far above, evoking a whole biosphere of niches without any single subject competing with the prose.
subject: An ultra-wide panoramic vista of an endless bioluminescent forest seen from a very high vantage, ridge after ridge of glowing canopy dissolving into deep atmospheric haze toward a faint horizon. No single creature or focal object; only the immense textured sweep of living land.
scene: Night over a continental forest, layered banks of haze separating distance into receding planes, faint drifting motes of light.
camera: Extreme high-altitude wide panorama, looking out and slightly down across the canopy to a distant horizon.
light: Very low contrast and dark overall; a dim even bioluminescent glow rising from the forest, no bright hotspot anywhere.
palette: Void indigo and deep teal-indigo dominant, faint cyan and living-teal glow in the canopy, no warm accent.
style: Painterly atmospheric mood plate, detail deliberately dissolving into haze.
detail_level: Low and soft throughout so overlaid long-form text stays readable; no crisp focal detail.
composition: Horizontal banding of receding hazy ridges, dark sky above, calm and immersive with no focal subject.
consistency_notes: Background layer behind the chapter, kept dim and low-contrast under a dark scrim. Distinct from the crisp fig-00 cover.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no UI chrome, no bright focal point, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares
